note: The semantic_index factory and local query worker select a dedicated process-wide query session instead of the build session. Tokenization, batch limits, mean pooling, normalization, model weights, fingerprints, query text, vectors, retrieval, ranking and rendering are unchanged. The change removes query waits behind indexing and idle model reloads; native fixture vector bits and tool-call parity defend numerical and tool response identity. Query and memory measurements are carried separately.
